headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 8, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves edged the Pittsburgh Pirates in a thrilling finish, securing a crucial 3-2 win. In other action, the Philadelphia Phillies took down the Chicago White Sox 9-5, while the New York Yankees dominated the Boston Red Sox 6-1.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Baltimore Orioles right-hander Chris Bassitt, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to low back discomfort. The Los Angeles Angels have also suffered a series of injuries, with Jack Kochanowicz, Gustavo Campero, and Jorge Soler all landing on the injured list.

The MLB trade market has been active, with several notable deals taking place. The Colorado Rockies acquired shortstop Richie Martin Jr. in a trade with the Texas Rangers, while the Chicago Cubs received left-hander Antoine Kelly from the Los Angeles Dodgers. The Milwaukee Brewers also made a move, acquiring right-hander Joel Kuhnel from the Athletics.

top_news.title: **Braves Edge Pirates in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-2, securing a crucial win. Spencer Horwitz led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Bubba Chandler pitched 5.1 strong innings for the Pirates.

top_news.title: **Phillies Take Down White Sox 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 5-9 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Brandon Marsh leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jonathan Bowlan pitched 2 strong innings for the White Sox, striking out 3 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Shut Down Red Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Boston Red Sox, winning 6-1 behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Jazz Chisholm Jr. led the Red Sox offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles dropped a 4-6 decision to the Toronto Blue Jays in their latest matchup. Taylor Ward led the Orioles' offense with a home run and two RBIs, while Adam Macko earned the win with a strong relief appearance.

top_news.title: **Bassitt Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Baltimore Orioles right-hander Chris Bassitt has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to low back discomfort, effective retroactive to June 5, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rockies Acquire Richie Martin Jr. in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies have acquired shortstop Richie Martin Jr. in a trade with the Texas Rangers. Martin Jr. joins the Rockies' roster after being dealt from the Rangers.
